items.requirement: Deliver local HTML and Markdown reports in Downloads and record the paths in the Dashboard.
Audit at least eight primary sources with links, year, I/O, assets, openness, reproducibility, and simulator-interface relation.
Provide the complete eight-capability method matrix.
Separate selection2env from generation2env and adjacent functions.
Give a P0/P1/P2 implementation shortlist with adopted, next, and deferred work.
Specify Zheng Ye to Gaochen handoff fields, artifacts, commands, and open blockers.
State the post-ASPIRE/ENPIRE differentiation as a testable hypothesis tied to schemas, gates, and experiments.

taxonomy.text2task: Generate task definitions, constraints, bindings, and success verifiers from language without necessarily changing the scene.
taxonomy.text2scene: Generate or assemble the spatial scene layout from language, including rooms, support surfaces, and object placement.
taxonomy.text2asset: Generate or reconstruct geometry, articulation, textures, materials, or physics metadata for assets.
taxonomy.selection2env: P0 route that retrieves and places existing execution-eligible assets, then emits reusable scene and task specs without inventing new geometry.
taxonomy.generation2env: P1/P2 route that creates missing assets or scenes and must pass geometry, scale, collision, support, material, import, and verifier gates before use.
taxonomy.sim_in_loop_repair: Run static and embodied checks, diagnose failures, patch scene/task/program specifications, and re-execute regression cases.
taxonomy.domain_randomization_data_generation: Generate controlled placement, appearance, language, embodiment, and trajectory variation for collection and training.
taxonomy.policy_eval_data_hook: Connect scene/task artifacts to collection, training, evaluation, diagnosis, promotion, and failure-to-data decisions.

shortlist.decision_window: Original weekly decision from 2026-07-01, re-audited against implementation state on 2026-07-13.

P0.decision: Adopt robotwin-text2env-demo as the concrete placement/scene-generation base.
Normalize RoboTwin and AgenticSim existing-asset candidates under selection2env.
Adopt FATE-style static-then-execution feasibility and active repair ordering.
P0.evidence: Static validation, generated rollout repair, and retained failure directories exist; generalized active repair remains future work.

P0.decision: Adopt ASPIRE-style trace completeness, held-out regression, and reusable repair evidence.
P0.evidence: Typed events, diagnosis, failure-to-data runs, and held-out evaluation exist; a promoted reusable skill library does not.

P1.decision: Use Articraft-10K as searchable metadata and gate each imported archive.
P1.evidence: 9,996 searchable entries, three SAPIEN/collision passes, and two missing-collision blockers.

P1.decision: Use SceneSmith retrieval and support-surface logic as the reference for broader reusable scenes.
P1.evidence: Source audited; SceneSmith code and datasets are not installed in this workspace.

P1.decision: Use video2sim-forge only when existing assets fail.
P1.evidence: Forge schema exists, but no RGB-D/reference-video input or imported generated asset exists.

P1.decision: Add REALM-style held-out perturbation and real-to-sim validation to policy evaluation.
P1.evidence: Held-out placements execute; policy remains 1/4 and no real-to-sim correlation study exists.

P2.decision: Add NeuMatEx-style material sidecars after geometry and physics are valid.
P2.evidence: Material-sidecar schema exists; multiview extraction and renderer import do not.

P2.decision: Add RLBench, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, LIBERO, Robosuite, BEHAVIOR, and REALM through /transfer adapters.
P2.evidence: Command spec describes adapters; same-task cross-simulator execution is not proven.

P2.decision: Attempt full generation2env only after import, collision, support, material, render, and verifier gates are automated.
P2.evidence: Current forge and material branches are explicit blockers, not executions.

open_blockers: Drawer articulation and interior-placement task API/verifier are not executable.
SceneSmith and video2sim-forge generation paths are not imported into RoboTwin/SAPIEN.
NeuMaTeX-style intrinsic neural material reconstruction is not reproduced; only a bounded observation-color sidecar roundtrip is executed.
No matched ASPIRE implementation or reusable skill-library comparison exists.
The promoted pose-conditioned policy is privileged and open-loop; visual, language-conditioned, closed-loop broad task generalization is not proven.

overlap.ASPIRE: Already covers multimodal trace debugging, code-as-policy repair, held-out validation, and reusable skill memory.
overlap.ENPIRE: Already covers real-world reset, execute, verify, refine, and coding-agent autoresearch loops.

innovation_after_aspire_enpire.claim_boundary: These dimensions define a testable PEARL system hypothesis, not established publication novelty or priority. Priority requires a broader related-work search and controlled comparative evidence.
acceptance_gates: Every scene has a stable scene_id and content hash independent of task bindings.
Every adapter declares asset, reset, step, observation, action, renderer, physics, and verifier contracts.
Every failure produces a typed diagnosis and next data or harness requirement.
Every proposed harness change runs regression cases before promotion and records rollback state.
Cross-simulator or real-robot claims require execution evidence on the target backend.

next_experiments.experiment: Run two different task specs from one byte-identical RoboTwin scene.
Run the same task through at least two simulator adapters with equivalent reset and verifier semantics.
Compare PEARL diagnosis/repair against an ASPIRE-style program-repair baseline on the same failures.
next_experiments.evidence: ASPIRE code is not released and no matched baseline is implemented.

next_experiments.experiment: Ablate persistent MCP memory and compare repeated failure localization and repair cost.
Demonstrate that failure-to-data retraining improves held-out task success enough to pass promotion.
next_experiments.evidence: Failure data was added and retraining executed, but held-out success remained 1/4.

next_experiments.experiment: Extract a material sidecar from an observation, bind it to a simulator-native shader, render, and compare.
Compare a predeclared failure score with verifier outcomes over at least twelve executable episodes.
Promote a declared learned policy only after varied-placement, domain-randomized, and cross-task execution gates pass.
next_experiments.evidence: artifacts/sceneagent_policy_promotion/pose_conditioned_policy_promotion_v1.json; scope is privileged pose-conditioned open-loop control.
